chunks: I said to Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام: “My father has performed hajj, my mother has performed hajj, and my two brothers have performed hajj. I wanted to include them in my hajj, as though I loved that they should be with me.”
So he عليه السلام said: “Include them with you, for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will assign for them a hajj, and for you a hajj, and for you a reward for maintaining ties with them.”

key_terms.إِيَّاهُمْ: with them; referring to those family members mentioned
key_terms.حَجَّتِي: my hajj; the pilgrim's own act of pilgrimage
key_terms.ٱجْعَلْهُمْ مَعَكَ: include them with you in the devotional reward or intention

ai.seo_question: Can I include my parents or siblings in the reward of my hajj after they have already performed hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a person may include close family members in his hajj intention even if they have already performed hajj. Allah grants them the reward of hajj while the pilgrim retains his own hajj and also receives reward for maintaining kinship ties.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: I said to Abu Abdullah (as): "My father has performed Hajj, my mother has performed Hajj, and my two brothers have also performed Hajj. I wish to include them in my Hajj, as I would love for them to be with me."
Imam (as) said: "Include them with you. Allah (swt), the Exalted, will grant them the reward of Hajj, and you will also have your Hajj, along with a reward for maintaining ties with them."
